lane: # Notes on the deps column: it is the image's BARE MINIMUM, not a convenience.
# A package joins it only when a real desktop of that family already ships it
# (gnupg on Debian/Ubuntu, libatomic on Fedora), or when the container itself
# cannot work otherwise (pacman's seccomp sandbox under colima's kernel).
# archlinux:base publishes no arm64 image, so on Apple Silicon that lane runs
# emulated x86_64 and the vendors' x64 binaries hit missing CPU features. It is
# CI-primary (ubuntu-latest is x86_64) and reports class 2 locally.
# ubuntu-paste mirrors ubuntu-base cell for cell except the entry point, which is
# what makes the apply-vs-paste differential meaningful: same image, same ids, so
# any disagreement is the entry point. It is also the only lane anywhere that runs
# the `bumpstart` bootstrap - the untested thing ADR 0003 exists to fix.
